decisions.reason: The task termination does not change or invalidate any specific audio-mixing attribute; the overlap is only through the removed ad deliverable.
The preview workflow had already occurred, and the source does not revise or remove any of its recorded workflow attributes.
Ending the commissioned deliverable does not establish a replacement creative strategy or make any existing creative-concept attribute stale.
The source addresses delivery speed and continuation of the task, not the script keywords, claims, or prohibited terms.
The source does not resolve or change the requested visual-production method or the existing uncertainty about AI-generated versus actual footage.
The task termination does not modify the recorded conversion objective, CPL target, or performance priority.
A same-message MODIFY already records the 12-hour window and consequence of leaving the task, and no additional attribute update or removal is entailed.
The source contains no decision changing the required hook approach, attention goal, or Indian-market fit.
